meta.name: WULMOJI_LEXICON_V0_1
meta.description: Frozen WULmoji v0.1 token table for DREAM_OF_CONQUEST simulation and non-sovereign symbolic communication. Forward-compatible: unknown tokens produce warnings, not errors.
meta.relation_to_formal_spec: docs/specs/WULMOJI_LEXICON_V0_1.json is a DREAM_OF_CONQUEST dialect. It does NOT supersede formal/wulmoji_spec_v1.txt (SYSTEM_A, 8 PROCESS primitives) or WUL_PACKET_SPEC_V0_1.md (inter-agent packet format). These are orthogonal systems retained per WULMOJI_V1_RECONCILIATION.md.

unknown_token_policy.behavior: Unknown grapheme clusters are emitted as AST nodes with class='UNKNOWN', type='UNKNOWN', and raw_codepoints preserved. Parsing continues. Hash includes the UNKNOWN node verbatim.
unknown_token_policy.reason: Lexicon may be extended in v0.2+ without breaking v0.1 parsers.

token_classes.O: Operator — actions and transformations applied to one or more operand expressions
token_classes.R: Relation — arrows and causal links; binary in canonical use
token_classes.D: Delimiter — structural scope markers; GROUP pair must balance; SEP and EOM are non-scoping
token_classes.M: Modality — speech-act type annotation; appears as prefix to the expression it qualifies
token_classes.E: Entity — semantic noun-like object; arity 0 (no direct operand)

tokens.description: Observe / attend / witness. Marks active notice of the operand.
Merge / synthesize. Binary operator combining two expressions into one composite.
Affirm / validate / accept. Marks the operand as verified or passing.
Negate / refuse / block. Marks the operand as rejected or forbidden.
Recurse / repeat / loop. Apply the operand repeatedly.
Recall / retrieve / restore from memory or prior state.
Delta / mutation / change signal. Marks a state transition on the operand.
Integrate / close loop / summarize. Marks completion of a cycle or proof.
Alert / escalate / urgent. Marks operand as requiring immediate attention.
Protect / guard / gate. Marks the operand as boundary-enforced or gate-cleared.
Pass / green / success. Marks the operand as having cleared a gate or check.
Fail / red / blocked. Marks the operand as failing a gate or check.
Warn / amber / caution. Marks the operand as requiring review before proceeding.
Link / reference / causal binding. Binary: left-expr LINK right-expr.
Flow / leads-to / sequential dependency. Right-arrow chaining.
Bidirectional link / mutual dependency / feedback loop.
Open group scope. Must be balanced by a GROUP_CLOSE (🔶). Imbalance is a hard error.
Close group scope. Must be paired with a preceding GROUP_OPEN (🔷). Imbalance is a hard error.
Repair marker / clarification boundary. Inline; does not open or close a scope.
Item separator / sequence boundary within a group.
End of message / final seal. No tokens may follow EOM in a well-formed expression.
Query / open variable / question. Speech-act prefix: the following expression is a question.
Command / directive / imperative. Speech-act prefix: the following expression is an instruction.
Assert / receipt-marker / formal claim. Speech-act prefix: the following expression is a stated fact.
Test / experiment / probe. Speech-act prefix: the following expression is a hypothesis under test.
Agent / cognition / decision-maker.
Composition / architecture / puzzle-piece. A structural or assembled element.
Reflection / mirror / introspection target.
Growth / living process / organic development.
Ambient field / background pressure / contextual medium.
Inference / prediction / forward projection.
Evidence / corpus / accumulated knowledge fragments. DREAM_OF_CONQUEST: knowledge_fragment pool.
Goal / target / success condition.
Plan / map / navigation structure.
Constraint / balance / gate condition / rule.
Artifact / package / delivered change. Marks a concrete output.
Signal / gate status / next-step indicator.
Home / keep / inalienable base. DREAM_OF_CONQUEST: HOME_KEEP_AVALON — automatic QUINT_CORE source.
Sovereign-proximity marker. Mandatory in KERNEL_ADJACENT WUL packets per WUL_PACKET_SPEC_V0_1.md §KERNEL_ADJACENT_RULES.
